On-device AI: why the next browser agent runs locally

Posted on March 2025 by the Example team · 8 minutes read

Large vision models no longer need a datacenter to be useful. This article walks through the architecture of a fully local perception stack: a quantized vision transformer classifies the screen, a lightweight detector finds faces, and a deterministic PII engine masks text — all before any network call happens.

The second section covers latency budgets. A sanitized 1280-pixel frame carries roughly a quarter of the vision tokens of a full-resolution capture, which is why on-device redaction is also a speed feature, not only a privacy feature.

Finally we look at failure policy: when a detector is unavailable the system must fail closed, never silently shipping pixels the user believed were protected.
